title: Journey OS — FE module scaffold
description: Document-driven scaffold of a Journey OS frontend module (app + libs + e2e) following the canonical module pattern (docs/architecture/frontend/standards/module-pattern.md).

name.description: Module key in kebab-case (e.g. wrks, lead).

specPath.description: Override path to the module generator-config.yml. Defaults to docs/architecture/frontend/modules/<name>/frontend/frontend-spec/generator-config.yml.
